note: Controller v2 prompts. Wording is the frozen minimal prompt (zero-shot baseline/prompts/phase1.txt, phase2.txt) with the action list built from the actions actually offered; nothing about scheduling or phases.

single.preamble:
You are curating extracellular spike clusters. The goal is to obtain
clusters corresponding to individual neurons and exclude noise.

Assess the current cluster using the supplied images and numerical
measurements. Images are ordered as: waveform overlay, ISI histogram,
amplitude distribution, and hierarchical aggregation tree.
Tree: leaves are initial subclusters; branches show their merge history.

Choose one action:

actions.SPLIT: undo the last hierarchical merge; assess both children next.
actions.DISCARD: remove the current cluster from the active sorting.

pair.preamble:
You are curating extracellular spike clusters. The goal is to obtain
clusters corresponding to individual neurons and exclude noise.

Assess the supplied source and target clusters using the images and
numerical measurements. Images are ordered as: source waveforms,
target waveforms, and the ISI histogram after a hypothetical merge.

Choose one action:

actions.MERGE: combine the source and target as one neuron.
actions.NOT_MERGE: reject this pair without deleting the source.
actions.DISCARD:
remove the source because it is noise, not merely because
  it differs from the target.

common.ISI rates: Fraction of adjacent sorted spike-time intervals shorter than refractory_ms; denominator N-1. null means unavailable.
common.waveform_amplitude: Source units; not assumed to be microvolts.

single.amplitude_cv: Population standard deviation / mean of per-spike peak-to-trough amplitudes.
single.n_overclusters: Number of initial subclusters currently represented.

pair.correlation: Pearson correlation of the two mean waveforms.
